```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = nzchar(Sys.getenv("ERW_LIVE_KEY")), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)
library(erw)
```

The six calls of the ERW packages (`docs/methods/packages.md`) are `erw_tables()`, `erw_coverage()`, `erw_fetch()`,
`erw_cite()`, `erw_license()` and `erw_standard()`. This vignette reproduces two of the site's charts from the live
set, as `packages/stata/examples.do` does in Stata, and prints the figures each shows so they can be checked against
the page at the same time. It runs when `ERW_LIVE_URL` and `ERW_LIVE_KEY` are set (the ERW gives them on request).

## The Grid tool, ERCOT: hourly demand, the last nine days

```{r ercot}
since <- format(Sys.Date() - 9, "%Y-%m-%d")
d <- erw_fetch("eia930_all_demand", entity = "eia930:ERCO", variable = "demand_mw", start = since)
d <- d[order(d$ts_utc), ]
cat(sprintf("ERCOT demand, last hour %s UTC: %s MW; the window's peak %s MW\n",
            format(d$ts_utc[nrow(d)], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC"),
            format(d$value[nrow(d)], big.mark = ","), format(max(d$value), big.mark = ",")))
plot(d$ts_utc, d$value, type = "l", xlab = "Hour (UTC)", ylab = "MW", main = "ERCOT demand, last nine days",
     sub = attr(d, "erw_version"))
```

## The price board: Henry Hub, the last twelve months

```{r henry}
since <- format(Sys.Date() - 365, "%Y-%m-%d")
h <- erw_fetch("eia_fuel_spot_prices", entity = "eia:henry_hub", start = since)
h <- h[order(h$ts_utc), ]
cat(sprintf("Henry Hub, latest %s: USD %.2f per MMBtu\n", format(h$ts_utc[nrow(h)], "%Y-%m-%d", tz = "UTC"),
            h$value[nrow(h)]))
plot(h$ts_utc, h$value, type = "l", xlab = "Day (UTC)", ylab = "USD per MMBtu",
     main = "Henry Hub spot price, last twelve months", sub = attr(h, "erw_version"))
erw_cite("eia_fuel_spot_prices", h)
```
